traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Cytisus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.63 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 4 records in 4 sources); trunks 0.63, branches 0.61. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the legume family (the DELTA distribution's own page for it, read 2026-10-15): flowers papilionaceous in Papilionoideae, commonly with the two ventral petals joined as the keel; calyx 5, gamosepalous in most Papilionoideae; androecium often 9-10; gynoecium of one carpel (usually), superior. That the stamens are fused in one tube in the genus is the genus's, not this page's. The Flora of New Zealand (vol. IV, Webb and others 1988) on Cytisus scoparius, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): corolla golden yellow, 16 to 25 mm long; stamens 10, joined in a tube.
